texts.preamble: S.Ajai Kumar vs The State Of Tamil Nadu on 31 July, 2019 Author: S.M.Subramaniam Bench: S.M.Subramaniam W.P.(MD)No.10079/20 Before The Madurai Bench Of Madras High Court Dated: 31.07.2019 Coram: The Honourable Mr.Justice S.M.Subramaniam W.P.(Md) No.10079 of 2013 S.Ajai Kumar ... Petitioner -Vs- 1.The State of Tamil Nadu, Represented by its Principal Secretary, Health and Family Welfare Department, Fort St. George, Chennai-600 009. 2.The Commissioner of Food Safety, Tamil Nadu Food Safety & Drug Administration Department, No.359, Anna Salai, Chennai-06. 3.Food Safety and Standards Authority of India, Represented by its Chairman, Ministry of Health and Family Welfare, 3rd Floor, Fda Bhawan, Kotla Road, New Delhi-110002. ... Respondents Prayer: Writ Petition filed under Article 226 of the Constitution of India for issuance of Writ of Mandamus, forbearing the second respondent from appointing / promoting any person as Designated Officer under the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006 without considering the petitioner (Food Inspector / Food Safety Officer) for post of Designated Officer in terms of Section 36 and Rule 2.1.2 of th Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006 and the Food Safety and Standards Rules, 2011. 1/4 http://www.judis.nic.in W.P.(MD)No.10079/ S.Ajai Kumar vs The State Of Tamil Nadu on 31 July, 2019 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/187873792/ 1 S.M.Subramaniam,J. For Petitioner : Mr.T.Lajapathi Roy For R1 and R2 : Mr.K.Mu.Muthu, Additional Government Pleader. For R3 : No Appearance Order
texts.facts: When the matter was taken up for hearing, the learned counsel appearing for the writ petitioner submitted that the relief sought for in this Writ Petition has become infructuous and he has also made an endorsement to that effect.
